claim: 中观为大乘两大哲学路线之一；'中道'名自避免常论与断灭论两极；学派立场是'最好通过否认事物有任何自性来实现'；svabhāva-śūnyatā 为学派旗帜。
locator: SEP Madhyamaka 开篇：'The Madhyamaka school of Buddhism ... was one of the two principal schools of Mahāyāna Buddhism in India, the other school being the Yogācāra'；'a middle path (madhyamā pratipad) that avoids the two extremes of eternalism—the doctrine that all things exist because of an eternal essence—and annihilationism—the doctrine that things have essences while they exist but that these essences are annihilated just when the things themselves go out of existence'；'this middle path is best achieved by a denial that things have any inherent natures at all. All things are, in other words, empty of inherent natures. This doctrine of universal emptiness of inherent natures (svabhāva-śūnyatā) is the hallmark of the school'
note: 2026-10-04 本任务独立 curl 抓取全文逐字核读（非复用 T01/F02 缓存）。

claim: 龙树为僧人、约150—250年间活动、主要在南印度（rarely disputed）；《中论》450颂；svabhāva 作为根本存在者或实体是批判主靶。
locator: SEP Nagarjuna：'That Nāgārjuna was a Buddhist monk who lived some time between 150 and 250 CE, probably mainly in southern India is rarely disputed.'；'In its 450 stanzas it expounds the entire compass of his thought and constitutes the central text of the "philosophy of the Middle Way"'；'It is the understanding of svabhāva as a primary existent or substance that constitutes the main target of Nāgārjuna's philosophical criticism.'
note: 站内 philosophers.json 龙树 era'约150—250年'与之一致（python 实查）。
uncertainty: 著述归属存在同名作者与托名问题（S2：'different authors bearing the name "Nāgārjuna" might have lived during different periods'），works 条已声明。

claim: 无'主论证'（master argument），中观对自性的驳斥必须逐步进行。
locator: SEP Nagarjuna：'we do not find a "master argument" to accomplish this'；'If nothing has its nature intrinsically and independently there can also be no argument for a particular thesis that by its very nature establishes its conclusion independent of the context in which it is made'；'The Madhyamaka refutation of svabhāva must proceed in a step-by-step manner.'
note: 方法论刻画，支撑 overview 第一段与 conclusion 第二段。

claim: 四句破（catuṣkoṭi）为四支穷尽性表述；MMK 1.1 为标本。
locator: IEP：'the "tetralemma" (catuṣkoṭi), a four-fold statement that is meant to identify all possible relations between any category and its putative explananda'；MMK 1.1 英译：'There do not exist, anywhere at all, any existents whatsoever, arisen either from themselves or from something else, either from both or altogether without cause'；维基文库《中論》卷第一汉译逐字：'諸法不自生　　亦不從他生　　不共不無因　　是故知無生'；青目释：'於四句中生不可得。是故不生。'
note: 中英两个文本传统分别独立核读，互证同一颂。
uncertainty: 当代争论：这种表面违反二值逻辑是否意味着非标准逻辑预设（IEP 原句 'One modern interpretive discussion concerns whether or not this apparent violation of bivalent logic...'）。

claim: 二谛为各家共同结构：日常经验层次与导向涅槃的层次；语言限于日常层次；分歧在二谛如何关联与论证的价值。
locator: SEP Madhyamaka：'In all of them one finds some version of the doctrine of two truths, according to which there is a level of understanding that consists of an accurate account of the world as it is experienced in everyday life and another level of understanding that is conducive to reaching the ultimate goal (paramārtha) of Buddhist practice, namely, nirvana, understood as the absence of attachment, aversion and delusion with no possibility of their return.'；'There is also broad agreement that language is limited to the everyday level of understanding'；'Where differences arise among Mādhyamika thinkers is on the issue of how these two truths relate to one another.'；'Is there any room within Madhyamaka for clear thinking and carefully wrought argumentation, or are all attempts to arrive at clear thought and rigorous argumentation ultimately delusional...'

claim: 与阿毗达磨二谛（两集存在物）的构成性对立。
locator: IEP：'the two truths basically consist in two sets of existing things: the set of conventionally existent (saṃvṛtisat) things and the set of ultimately existent (parmārthasat) things'；'The works of Nāgārjuna and his philosophical heirs are best understood as constitutively opposed to this understanding of the two truths.'
note: 支撑 overview 第二段中观二谛与部派对照，划清与阿毗达磨的界线。

claim: 虚无主义指控与《中论》的自我设靶回应：'以有空義故一切法得成'；空=缘起而非无。
locator: 维基文库《中論》卷第四〈觀四諦品〉设问偈逐字：'若一切皆空　　無生亦無滅　　如是則無有　　四聖諦之法'；答偈：'以有空義故　　一切法得成　　若無空義者　　一切則不成'；IEP：MMK 24.1 英译 'If all this is empty, then there's neither production nor destruction; it follows, for you, that the Four Noble Truths don't exist.'，MMK 24.19 'Since there is no dharma whatsoever that is not dependently originated, therefore there is no dharma whatsoever that is not empty.'；指控来源：'Mādhyamikas recurrently elicited charges of nihilism – a charge as often issuing from proponents of other Buddhist schools as from the various Brahmanical schools of Indian philosophy.'
note: S2 佐证：'the Mādhyamikas themselves are very clear that their position avoids both of the extreme views, the view that believes in the existence of svabhāva as well as its nihilistic opposite.'

claim: 中观哲学史主要是注释史：关键文本由对龙树著述（最多被注为 MMK 与 VV）的注释构成；汉藏译传不对称。
locator: SEP Madhyamaka：'The key texts of the school comprised commentaries to the writings of Nāgārjuna—the works of Nāgārjuna most often commented upon are the Mūla-madhyamaka-kārikā (MMK) and Vigraha-vyāvartanī (VV)'；'A few of the Sanskrit treatises ... were translated into Chinese and became the basis of a short-lived school of Chinese Buddhism. A significant number of Sanskrit Madhyamaka texts were eventually translated into Tibetan and exerted considerable influence on the intellectual heritage of Tibetan Buddhism.'；IEP：'the Chinese canon does not include the works of such thinkers as Candrakīrti, Dharmakīrti, or Śāntarakṣita'

claim: 清辨主张中观人有可陈述可捍卫的主张：'一切现象都无自性……一切现象都是待缘的'。
locator: SEP Madhyamaka：'He affirmed that Mādhyamikas do have a conviction that they are prepared to state and defend, namely, that all phenomena are devoid of an inherent nature, that is, a nature that they have independently. All phenomena are conditioned, and such natures as they have are natures that they acquire through their conditions rather than on their own.'
note: 此句同时为 S4（'all phenomena are conditioned...'）同类表述的本条独立复核版本。

claim: 自续/应成二名为藏地学僧在月称身后许多世纪追认；术语非印度中观人自用；但已成现代学术标准做法。
locator: SEP Madhyamaka：'Many centuries after he wrote, Buddhist scholastics in Tibet portrayed Candrakīrti as the founder of one of the subschools of the Madhyamaka that they perceived.'；'Because Bhāvaviveka had advocated for producing independent (svatantra) arguments ..., the Tibetan scholastics dubbed his subschool the Svātantrika school; because Candrakīrti criticized that approach and advocated for being content to show the unwelcome consequences (prasaṅga) of all possible positions ..., his subschool was named by Tibetans the Prāsaṅgika school of Madhyamaka.'；'Although those terms were not used by Indian Mādhyamikas themselves, it has become standard practice in modern scholarship to portray the Madhyamaka school as comprising at least two subschools with those names'
note: 本包核心争议证据（任务要点'后世追认还是当时自觉'）。IEP 侧证见 /school/cihai/7 条。
uncertainty: 藏地内部定型年代学未核读。

claim: 自续/应成分歧的性质之争：只是论辩策略之别还是本体论预设之别；判教透镜反映藏地关切；但有印度文本依据。
locator: IEP：'Much contemporary debate has concerned whether these divergent lines of interpretation reflect only differing dialectical strategies, or whether (as influential Tibetan proponents of the distinction claim) they involve significantly different ontological presuppositions.'；'this doxographic lens is of interest partly for what it can tell us about some characteristically Tibetan preoccupations'；'Although the characterizations of these two trajectories of interpretation are not without basis in the antecedent Indian texts ...'
note: 另载影响史不对称：'Tibetan interpreters generally claim to take the seventh-century commentaries of Candrakīrti as authoritative, but Indian commentators subsequent to him were in fact more influential in the course of Indian philosophy.'（藏地尊月称而印度实为自续系更有影响）。

claim: 中观与瑜伽行论辩：早期驳斥、后期留位；月称批评瑜伽行未承认意识本身亦空；寂护—莲花戒为'伟大综合者'。
locator: SEP Madhyamaka：'Early Mādhyamikas tended to refute the Yogācāra doctrine that all the contents within awareness arise out of awareness itself and are thus ontologically at one with consciousness. Later Mādhyamikas found room for that view, usually by portraying Yogācāra as a philosophy that prepares one ... for the difficult truth that all things are lacking in inherent natures'；月称：'the Yogācāra philosophers fail to acknowledge that everything, including consciousness itself, is empty.'；SEP Yogācāra：'Śāntarakṣita and his disciple Kamalaśīla ... are often referred to as the "great synthesisers" of Madhyamaka and Yogācāra.'；'described by Tibetan doxographers as "Yogācāra-Svātantrika-Madhyamaka"'

claim: 《解深密经》'三转法轮'自我定位：瑜伽行自称了义、视阿毗达磨与中观为前期不完善阐释。
locator: SEP Yogācāra：'The Saṃdhinirmocana Sūtra is particularly known for its self-description as the "third turning of the wheel of the doctrine", by which it means that the Yogācāra tenets represent the culmination and definitive interpretation of the Buddha's teachings, in contrast to the earlier "inadequate" expositions offered by the Abhidharma and Madhyamaka schools.'
note: 论辩的对侧视角，用于 subSchools/瑜伽行中观与 overview 第四段的平衡呈现。

claim: 藏地接受：寂护约763年入藏、任桑耶寺首任住持、788卒、莲花戒继之；影响延续至今。
locator: SEP Madhyamaka：'he went to Tibet in about 763 and became the first abbot of Bsam-yas monastery'；'When Śāntarakṣita died in 788, he was succeeded by Kamalaśīla, who lived until 795.'；'Together Śāntarakṣita and Kamalaśīla ... set the tone for Buddhist scholasticism in the eighth century, and their influence is felt in Tibetan Buddhism to this day.'
uncertainty: 顿渐之争'发生本身可能系虚构'（S3：'while the occurrence of the debate itself may be apocryphal'），timeline 已注明，汉方名号不写。

claim: 宗喀巴整合月称应成与法称量论、创格鲁派；Go-ram-pa 的批判把二谛问题带入藏地内部论争。
locator: IEP：'the prolific scholar Tsong-kha-pa (1357-1419) – originator of the influential reformist school that would style itself the "dGe-lugs" ("virtuous way") – did much to integrate the Prāsaṅgika Madhyamaka of Candrakīrti with the understanding and teaching of Buddhist epistemology stemming from Dharmakīrti. Tsong-kha-pa's works (such as the massive Lam rim chen mo...)'; 'Critics of Tsong-kha-pa – such as, notably, the Sa-skya-pa scholar Go-ram-pa bSod-nams seng-ge (1429-1489) – stridently condemned his confidence that the discourse of epistemology could bring Mādhyamika analysis into contact with ultimate reality.'
note: 站内 philosophers.json 实有'宗喀巴·罗桑扎巴'（14世纪-15世纪，school 含'中观应成派'），姓名纪年采用站内（python 实查）。
uncertainty: '应成为格鲁唯一了义'的课程细节未核读（见 packet.evidenceLimits）。

claim: 解读《中论》需要'相当程度的理性重构'；影响史与正统叙事不同构。
locator: IEP：'almost any attempt at understanding the texts of Nāgārjuna and his commentators is likely to require a considerable effort of rational reconstruction'；'According to Tibetan doxographical literature, Madhyamaka represents the philosophically definitive expression of Buddhist doctrine.'；'Tibetan interpreters generally claim to take the seventh-century commentaries of Candrakīrti as authoritative, but Indian commentators subsequent to him were in fact more influential in the course of Indian philosophy.'

claim: 文本存世形态残缺：佛护注仅藏译；清辨注存汉藏两译；《明句论》为唯一梵本存世的《中论》注并保存《中论》梵颂。
locator: SEP Madhyamaka（Buddhapālita）：'The original Sanskrit of this text is not known to exist, but it is still extant in Tibetan translation.'；（Bhāvaviveka）：'now extant only in Chinese and Tibetan translations'；（Candrakīrti）：'which survives in Sanskrit as well as in Tibetan translation'；IEP：'Prasannapadā ("Clear Words") – the only commentary on the MMK known to be extant in Sanskrit – preserves the Sanskrit text of Nāgārjuna's verse text.'

claim: 龙树：僧人、约150—250、南印度；《中论》核心文本；svabhāva 主靶；无主论证、逐步归谬；著述归属有同名与托名问题。
locator: S2 三句（见 /school/overview 第2条 locator）；归属：'it is not easy to come up with a precise list of texts Nāgārjuna composed ... different authors bearing the name "Nāgārjuna" might have lived during different periods ... the tendency of attributing newly composed works to the great authorities of the past'
note: 站内姓名'龙树'、era'约150—250年'、school'中观派（Madhyamaka）'取自 philosophers.json（python 实查）。

claim: 提婆：fl. ca. 225—250（藏汉传统传记）；传统所记龙树直传弟子；《四百论》为关键中观文本、月称为之作注；护法注与月称注之分有时被视为两派分裂先声。
locator: SEP Madhyamaka：'According to traditional accounts preserved in Tibetan and Chinese, Āryadeva (fl. ca. 225–250 C.E.) ... He reportedly became a direct disciple of Nāgārjuna. His principal writing, the Catuḥśataka śāstra (Four Hundred Verse Treatise), was regarded as a Madhyamaka text and was commented on by Candrakīrti'；IEP：'the divergent interpretations of it by the commentators Dharmapāla (530-561) and Candrakīrti are sometimes taken to herald a decisive split between Madhyamaka and Yogācāra (see Tillemans 1990)'
note: 站外人物（philosophers.json 无'提婆'，python 实查）。
uncertainty: 师承仅'traditional accounts'/'reportedly'，无独立确证；relation 已标注。

claim: 佛护：约470—540（IEP 作 fl. c. 500）；现存最早《中论》注作者；纯归谬不立正面立场；另一《无畏注》系于龙树而作者归属被质疑。
locator: SEP Madhyamaka：'the earliest extant commentary to Nāgārjuna's MMK is the Madhyamakavṛtti by Buddhapālita (ca. 470–ca. 540). The original Sanskrit of this text is not known to exist, but it is still extant in Tibetan translation.'；'Buddhapālita's commentary does not offer a positive position but rather shows the untenability of all the apparently possible solutions'；'The principal method ... is to show that unwelcome consequences are entailed by the position under consideration.'；《无畏注》：'a commentary entitled Akutobhaya ... which is traditionally ascribed to Nāgārjuna but the authorship of which is questioned by modern scholars'
note: 站外人物。IEP 独立口径：'Buddhapālita (fl. c. 500), the author of a complete commentary (now extant only in Tibetan translation) on the MMK'。
uncertainty: 生卒无定年，两源口径并陈。

claim: 清辨：6世纪中叶（IEP c. 500—570）；对佛护注释传统的最强挑战；主张正面立论；用陈那规范；汉译名'分別明'。
locator: SEP Madhyamaka：'The strongest challenge to the commentarial tradition of Buddhapālita came from Bhāvaviveka, whose approach to Madhyamaka became the basis of what Tibetan Buddhists would many centuries after the fact consider a subschool of Madhyamaka that rivaled the subschool comprising those who followed Buddhapālita.'；'Bhāvaviveka, who was also known as Bhavya and Bhāviveka, was probably active in the middle part of the sixth century.'；'In providing arguments ..., Bhāvaviveka followed the example set by Dignāga (fl. ca. 510)'；维基文库《般若燈論》题记逐字：'般若燈論十五卷　龍樹菩薩本　分別明菩薩釋　唐波羅頗迦羅蜜多羅譯'
note: 站外人物；'分別明'汉译名经维基文库逐字核读。
uncertainty: 生卒两源口径并陈。

claim: 月称：7世纪初（IEP c. 600—650）；《明句论》梵本存世并保存《中论》梵颂；《入中论》为藏地课程主文本；在印度影响有限、经藏地传统重塑地位。
locator: SEP Madhyamaka：'Modern scholars place him at the beginning of the seventh century. His two best-known works are his commentary to MMK entitled Prasannapadā Madhyamakavṛtti ..., which survives in Sanskrit as well as in Tibetan translation, and an independent treatise called Madhyamakāvatāra ... available only in Tibetan translation.'；IEP：'Candrakīrti (c. 600-650), whose Prasannapadā ("Clear Words") – the only commentary on the MMK known to be extant in Sanskrit – preserves the Sanskrit text'；'Candrakīrti ... would exercise little influence in India, though he re-emerges with the Tibetan tradition's interest in him.'；'the Madhyamakāvatāra ... represents the principal text for the "Madhyamaka" component of many Tibetan monastic curricula.'
note: 站外人物。

claim: 寂护：卒于788（IEP 725—788）；约763年入藏、桑耶寺首任住持；《摄真实论》3645颂、《中观庄严论》97颂；综合唯识与中观（'乘二宗之车为一体'）。
locator: SEP Madhyamaka：'Śāntarakṣita's magnum opus is a composition entitled Tattva-saṃgraha ..., which contains 3645 verses.'；'his most original contribution ... Madhyamakālaṃkāra ..., which contains ninety-seven stanzas'；综合喻：'by embracing the doctrine of mind only, one stops taking external objects as real; then by embracing Madhyamaka, one realizes that no objects at all have substance; then, taking the reins of reasoning, one rides the chariot of both systems as a single great vehicle (mahāyāna).'；入藏与年代见 /school/overview 第14条 locator。
note: 站外人物；莲花戒（Kamalaśīla，卒于795）为其弟子、继任者，本包不单设 thinker（材料见 S1/S4，随寂护条呈现）。

claim: 阿底峡（982—1054）：后期应成解释代表之一、印度佛教传入西藏的关键人物、著《菩提道灯论》。
locator: IEP：'Significant later Prāsaṅgikas include ... Dīpaṃkaraśrījñāna (982-1054; more popularly known as "Atiśa"), who figured prominently in the transmission of Indian Buddhism to Tibet, where he lived when he wrote the Bodhipathapradīpa ("A Lamp for the Path to Awakening").'

claim: 宗喀巴（1357—1419）：格鲁派创立者；整合月称应成中观与法称量论；巨著《菩提道次第广论》；遭 Go-ram-pa（1429—1489）批判。
locator: IEP（见 /school/overview 第15条 locator）；'Tsong-kha-pa's works ... also bring considerable sophistication to bear on the question of how Madhyamaka ought to be understood in relation to Yogācāra.'

claim: 龙树→佛护：现存最早《中论》注释关系。
locator: SEP Madhyamaka：'the earliest extant commentary to Nāgārjuna's MMK is the Madhyamakavṛtti by Buddhapālita (ca. 470–ca. 540)'；'The key texts of the school comprised commentaries to the writings of Nāgārjuna'

claim: 佛护→清辨：清辨批评佛护不立因喻、不合量论规范；印度论辩传统视只破不立为 vitaṇḍā。
locator: IEP：'Bhāvaviveka then specifically took Buddhapālita to task, urging that Buddhapālita's elaboration of the argument was unreasonable "because no reason and no example are given and because faults stated by the opponent are not answered"'；SEP Madhyamaka：'To criticize the positions of others but not to venture to state a position of one's own was regarded by the Indian debate tradition as a substandard use of argumentation called vitaṇḍā, which literally means making an attack.'

claim: 清辨→月称：月称《明句论》开篇为佛护辩护、对清辨持续批评；量论奠基两难；'无主张'与不可驳倒论。
locator: SEP Madhyamaka：'At the beginning of his commentary to MMK, Candrakīrti offers an extended criticism of Bhāvaviveka and a defense of Buddhapālita against the criticisms of Bhāvaviveka.'；'Nāgārjuna had written in VV that he has no thesis to advance.'；'the Mādhyamika cannot be refuted, precisely because he has no position to defend'；两难：'If it requires a warrant of its own, the result will be an infinite regress of propositions needing warrants; if it is declared self-validating, then why not say of all propositions they are self-validating?'
